text:
I gave a poetry reading last Saturday in

the woods outside Santa Cruz

and was about to finish

when I heard a loud, long scream

and a fairly pretty young woman

ran toward me

long dress and fire in her eyes

and jumped onto the stage

and screamed: “I WANT YOU!

I WANT YOU! Eat me! Eat me!”

I told her, “hey,

leave me alone, fuck.”

But she kept taking off

my clothes and throwing herself

on me.

“Where were you,” I

asked, “when I had nothing

to eat and

sent stories to the

Atlantic Monthly?”

she grabbed my balls and nearly

tore them off. Her kisses

tasted like shit soup.

2 women jumped onto the stage

and

dragged her off

into the woods.

Her screams could still be heard

when I began the next poem.

Maybe, I thought, I should have

possessed her on stage in front

of all those eyes.

But you never know

if it would be a good poem or

a bad acid.
